articles.title: AWS announces general availability of AWS Interconnect
articles.summary: AWS Interconnect now links AWS and Microsoft Azure privately, replacing the do-it-yourself networking customers previously had to build.

articles.title: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
articles.summary: The initiative aims to establish open, industrywide standards for AI security, governance, and transparency across models and providers to help enterprises independently verify AI agent behavior.

articles.title: AI is blurring the lines between CIO, CISO, and CRO
articles.summary: Autonomous agentic AI in enterprise environments blurs traditional organizational lines between the CIO, CISO, and CRO because current governance models rely on human decision structures that are too slow. As agents make rapid operational decisions with broad consequences, organizations lack clear definitions of operational authority and risk ownership. Companies need to establish explicit decision mandates, pre-agreed tie-breaks, and comprehensive decision trails to maintain human accountability.

articles.title: A bottle-cap manufacturer offers a reality check on AI
articles.summary: A manufacturer's presentation challenged the assumption that every business process is ready for AI automation, pointing to aging equipment, limited digital skills, and thin margins. Successful adoption starts with understanding employees' practical knowledge and operational constraints.

articles.title: Put Gemini to work for you
articles.summary: Gemini Tasks can perform agentic actions such as calling businesses, booking appointments, managing calendars, and completing purchases via Google Pay. The assistant integrates with Google apps like Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive, and Calendar to handle multi-step projects and routine busywork. The new features are powered by Google's latest Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.

articles.title: Windows security at Ignite 2026: Start secure, protect what matters, prepare for AI
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced general availability of its Windows endpoint security platform, which gives third-party security vendors a way to protect systems without relying as heavily on kernel-level software. Developers can use the new API to warn users, limit functionality, or block applications from running if a PC fails the security check.

articles.title: Enterprise Deployment of Governed Agents on Windows
articles.summary: Windows and Microsoft tools are working together to support enterprise deployment of governed AI agents through identity, containment, and management primitives. Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Microsoft Execution Containers provide platform-enforced boundaries, while Microsoft Intune, Defender, and Purview extend management, runtime protection, and data loss prevention to local agent workloads.

articles.title: Java4Shell flaw exposes widely used enterprise applications
articles.summary: Oracle patched a Java vulnerability that can let unauthenticated attackers execute code or crash affected systems. Researchers demonstrated attacks against applications including Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Elasticsearch, with exposure depending on the underlying Java version and CPU configuration.

articles.title: Intel secures expanded Azure infrastructure partnership
articles.summary: Microsoft's expanded Intel agreement includes multi-year Xeon supply and plans to use Intel's EMIB packaging technology for Azure's own chips.

articles.title: The knowledge layer for enterprise AI: Domain Ontology
articles.summary: A Neo4j-based ontology helps enterprise AI agents interpret ambiguous business terms using governed definitions, rules, and provenance.
